brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two full-depth solid bins placed: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full in two adjacent base cells (piece:0,0,0 and piece:1,0,0) joined with jointBolt:0#0,0#0. meshClash clear.

Used solid-wall bins (hex-bin-full) without drain holes, which will retain liquid, but Hex Cluster configurator does not model material sealing or waterproof rating; no verification of leak-proof performance available. Drained variants avoided.

Catalog search for PETG/PLA/food-safe material returned no selectable material property; configurator checks fit/mesh only (check_build OK) and does not verify temperature or dishwasher material compatibility, so dishwasher safety cannot be claimed from build.

finish.summary: Built 2-cell base with two solid full-depth bins for utensils and added joint bolt; meshClash clear. Solid bins chosen to approach waterproof vs drained variants, but neither waterproof nor dishwasher-safe is a verifiable property in the configurator.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
